extension.summary: Browse and watch YouTube with the TV layout
extension.description: Browse YouTube the way the TV app shows it: the TV sidebar, shelves, subscriptions, library and search, with full video information and DASH/HLS playback through InputStream Adaptive. Sign in with a TV code, customise the main menu, hide Shorts or watched videos, and set preferred quality, codec and subtitle languages.
extension.news: v8.0.0~beta1 - New add-on built around YouTube's TV layout: the TV sidebar, shelves, subscriptions, library and search - Sign in with a TV code, with multiple accounts - DASH/HLS playback through InputStream Adaptive - Plugin paths from earlier versions keep working
